import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# 1. Survival by passenger class and sex (top-left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Passenger Class and Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Male', '1st Female', '2nd Male', '2nd Female', '3rd Male', '3rd Female'], rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival (top-middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([not_survived_age, survived_age], bins=20, stacked=False, 
         color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], alpha=0.7, label=['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Survival rate by passenger class (top-right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
survival_rate = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean() * 100
bars = ax3.bar(survival_rate.index.astype(str), survival_rate.values, 
               color=['#3498db', '#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 100)
for bar, rate in zip(bars, survival_rate.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{rate:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 4. Fare distribution by survival (middle-left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sns.boxplot(x='survived', y='fare', data=df, ax=ax4, palette=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Survived (0=No, 1=Yes)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])

# 5. Survival by embarkation port (middle-middle)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack()
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax5, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax5.set_title('Survival by Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival')
ax5.set_xticklabels(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# 6. Family size vs survival (middle-right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean() * 100
bars = ax6.bar(family_survival.index.astype(str), family_survival.values, color='#9b59b6')
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 100)
for bar, rate in zip(bars, family_survival.values):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
             f'{rate:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 7. Survival by age group and sex (bottom row spanning all columns)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child (<12)', 'Teen (12-18)', 'Young Adult (19-30)', 
                                 'Adult (31-50)', 'Senior (>50)'])
age_sex_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack().unstack()
age_sex_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax7.set_title('Survival by Age Group and Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age Group & Sex')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count')
ax7.legend(['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival')
ax7.set_xticklabels(ax7.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
